full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white mixed-media portrait shows a man's face turned to the right, fragmented by layered architectural shapes and distressed graphic marks. The close crop cuts through the forehead and lower neck, while the projecting nose, lips and chin remain readable near the right side. One closed or lowered eyelid lies beneath a thick dark brow. Fine photographic grain and soft grey shading model the cheek, nose and mouth, with dark accents at the nostril and between the lips. The left side of the face merges into a dense stack of black rectangles, pale building-like slabs, small window-like grids and thin linear seams. Similar fragments cross the forehead and lower jaw, breaking the portrait into overlapping planes. Some edges are sharply rectangular, while others dissolve into scratches, rubbed grey patches and scattered specks. Dark horizontal strokes stretch across the brow area, contrasting with the many upright architectural strips along the left. The right background is comparatively pale and open, although faint grey marks continue around the profile. This light area separates the nose and mouth from the busier left half. Near the lower edge, vertical black-and-white pieces overlap the chin and neck, suggesting a city-like structure embedded in the portrait rather than a separate background scene. Soft facial modelling remains visible within the abrupt collage interruptions. Near-black blocks, silver-grey midtones and off-white fields keep the image tightly monochromatic. The composition balances the smooth projecting profile against dense rectilinear fragments, with an uneven distribution of dark weight and pale space creating a tense, layered graphic portrait.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形黑白综合媒介肖像，一名男子侧脸朝右，面孔被层叠建筑形状与磨损图形痕迹切分。近距离裁切穿过额头和下部颈项，向外突出的鼻子、嘴唇与下巴在右侧仍可辨认。一只闭合或低垂的眼睑位于浓深眉毛下方。细微摄影颗粒和柔和灰调塑造脸颊、鼻子与嘴部，鼻孔及唇缝处有深色强调。脸部左侧融入密集黑矩形、浅色建筑般板块、小窗格般网纹与细接缝。类似碎片横过额头及下颌，把肖像拆成重叠平面。有些边缘呈锐利矩形，另一些则消融为划痕、擦抹灰块与散点。深色横笔穿过眉部，与左侧众多竖向建筑条块形成对照。右侧背景相对浅亮开阔，但淡灰痕迹仍延续至侧脸周围。这片亮区让鼻子和嘴部从繁密左半部中分离。靠近下沿，竖向黑白片块覆盖下巴与颈项，像城市结构嵌入肖像之中，而不是独立背景场景。柔和面部塑形在突兀拼贴中断之间仍可见。近黑块、银灰中间调与米白色域使画面保持严格单色。构图以平滑凸出的侧脸平衡密集直线碎片，暗色重量与浅色空间不均匀分布，形成紧张、层叠的图形肖像。
style_prompt_en: The style combines high-contrast monochrome imagery with abrupt geometric interruptions and smeared tonal fragments. Pale planes sit beside dense black masses, while small grey marks bridge the two. Edges shift between clean contours, scratches, and blocky breaks. The palette remains narrow, and light is softened enough to preserve intermediate tones within the strong contrast. Tight cropping and asymmetrical distribution create visual pressure. The overall effect feels graphic, disrupted, and tactile, with structure repeatedly interrupted by fragmented surface marks.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格将高反差黑白影像与突兀几何断裂、拖抹色调碎片结合起来。浅色平面紧邻浓重黑块，少量灰色痕迹连接二者。边缘在清晰轮廓、擦痕和块状中断之间变化。色谱范围狭窄，光线又足够柔和，能在强烈反差中保留中间调。紧密裁切和不对称分布带来视觉压力。整体效果图形化、受扰且具有触感，连续结构会被碎片表面痕迹反复打断。
theme_en: A monochrome male profile fragmented by architectural collage
theme_zh: 建筑拼贴碎片中的黑白男性侧脸
name: Jock
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
